title: Running, editing and saving
body:
Execution state

READY accepts commands. RUNNING executes statements. INPUT waits for a response. STOPPED retains a resumable execution. ENDED finished normally. ERROR shows the source line and a diagnostic. The status remains above the transcript.

CommandBehavior
NEWClears source and continuation; virtual media remains.
LISTDisplays stored lines in numeric order.
EDIT nRetrieves a line; cancel preserves execution and RNG. Commit discards continuation.
RUNStarts with fresh variables, DATA cursor and configured seed. Closes positive file handles; tapes remain mounted.
STOP / Ctrl-CInterrupts running or pending INPUT. At INPUT, use the button, Ctrl-C or /STOP; a bare STOP is program input.
CONTResumes live STOP state, including unfinished INPUT. Cannot resume after an error or budget exhaustion.
HELPDisplays a short environment reference.

At READY, Up/Down navigates command history and restores your draft on returning to the newest entry. History is disabled while EDIT is active. Clear screen removes only the displayed transcript. Latest output scrolls to the prompt without changing the program.

Three different things to keep

  • Source (.bas): numbered text; no selected dialect or seed.
  • Workspace JSON v1: source, dialect and seed. No running machine snapshot and no virtual media.
  • Media image JSON v1: named virtual records. No source, mounts, cursor positions or RNG state.

Save workspace locally uses this browser’s storage. A different origin/browser cannot see it; file-URL storage may be unavailable. Export gives you a portable download. Import validates before replacing the workspace and never executes it automatically. Apply/Cancel protects an unapplied editor draft. Settings changes and committed edits invalidate CONT.

Display and focus

Choose 40 or 80 columns and green, amber or white phosphor. The scrollback is a labeled, keyboard-focusable region. Fullscreen expands the Computer where the browser permits; a focus view is the fallback. Escape or Exit fullscreen returns. Browser zoom and native keyboard navigation remain available.

Determinism

Advanced settings exposes the seed. The same source, profile, seed and inputs produce the same random sequence. This is a host generator, not a historical hardware RNG. RUN restarts it. Export media before closing; live device storage is not automatically persisted.
